title: Bring core under 25,000 lines
goal: Vision: V-9. CEO decision 2026-11-18 (Mandate 84, options 1 and 2 together): remove from core, after Susi Commercial Apps holds each piece (T-CLAUDE25K-1), (1) the unused Provider trait, (2) the installed channel, keeping only the paired-runtime forward core's launcher needs, and (3) the Windows facade modules core no longer uses; then find the last lines needed so the complete socket is strictly below 25,000, lowering the ceiling to the measure at every step.

reuse.searched: Susi Commercial Apps receives each piece by transplant (T-CLAUDE25K-1); core keeps contracts and forwards.

progress: 2026-11-18: step 1 done (Provider trait moved; core 29,565). Steps 2 and 3 need a native Windows host: every remaining piece is cfg(windows) and its tests are Windows-only (src/installed_channel/tests.rs). Step 2 is a redesign, not a transplant: `install-release` trusts env::current_exe() as the exact package executable (manage_in_view: Package::open(exe.parent()), verify_entry(&exe)) and host_task schedules current_exe with --host-worker, so a Susi Commercial Apps controller needs an explicit, digest-verified package path and its own scheduled-task image. Planned split: Commercial Apps' susi-cli-runtime implements install-release (today it calls back into core via run_core_words), taking transaction management (apply, apply_managed, bootstrap, finish, manage), host_task.rs, channel_bindings.rs + shell_link.rs and the Windows tests; core keeps the launch path (is_dispatcher, run_in_place, start_selected, dispatch, the read-only Package checks it uses, runtime.rs paired_runtime) and `susi install` (the free core's first install). xtask installed_delivery.rs must run the paired susi-commercial for install-release; its supports_installer fallback already uses the previous release as controller. Estimated: -2,500 lines. Step 3 (CEO option 1, approved 2026-11-18): reviewed unsafe code may live in Susi Commercial Apps; move winapi detached, process_job, socket and stdio (no core user; Commercial Apps uses them via the pin) and environment once step 2 removes its last core user (~840 lines); amend Commercial Apps AGENTS.md section 3 and docs/ceo-mandate-84.md, gate the crate with the unsafe ratchet. After steps 2 and 3 core is about 26,200; the rest must come from shared non-Windows code.
